title: TWIN PEAKS
subtitle: Across the Eras
blurb: All 48 hours — the ABC run of 1990–91 and Showtime's 2017 Return — laid out episode by episode: the Laura Palmer case, the Lodge, the town, and who's playing the Roadhouse.
regularsNote: Cooper, the Palmers, the Hornes, the sheriff's station and the rest of the S1–2 regulars aren't listed per-episode — use the chart rows and the spotlight tags for them. Guest cast is fullest for The Return, where most of the returning townspeople are credited as guests.
chartHint: Click any bar to filter episodes. Click a season header to filter by season, an episode number to open it. Shift-click to combine.
credits: Episode data via TVmaze. Fire Walk With Me (1992) is a film, not an episode — it lives in the 25-year gap between column 30 and column 31.
